blockchain: A digital ledger that records transactions securely
soulbound: A token that cannot be transferred - forever tied to owner
contract: An automated program that runs on the blockchain
gasFee: Transaction fee paid to process blockchain operations
polygon: A fast, low-cost Ethereum-compatible blockchain network
ipfs: Decentralized storage system for permanent file hosting
nft: Non-fungible token - a unique digital asset
wallet: A digital wallet for storing cryptocurrencies and tokens
verification: Checking a credential's authenticity on the blockchain
